notes: 판본은 gamepack RIO531 2판 기본판으로 한정한다. 확장판은 포함하지 않는다.
SVG는 독창적인 카드 뒷면/영역 도식이며 실제 카드 삽화나 상업용 organizer 그림을 복제하지 않는다.
카드 수/종류/더미 구성·위치, 각 플레이어 손패·플레이·버림·덱·aside, 현재 행동/구입/돈, 활성 플레이어·phase/pending 상태를 별도 보존할 수 있도록 표면과 JSON을 제공한다.
손패는 소유자 전용이고 뽑기 덱의 카드 내용/순서는 숨김이다. 모르는 값을 빈 수량 또는 0으로 바꾸지 않는다.
기본 공급 더미 17개는 실제 설정 슬롯으로, 각 pile의 카드 개수는 플레이어 수와 pile 종류에 따라 JSON state에 기록한다.
Asset completion is independent of later app wiring. This package has the whole table and explicit physical-state JSON; it supplies no app/rules engine.
Known top/identity/order and unknown information are distinct. Randomizer and blank cards are outside the active table; the inventory decomposition includes them.

structureEvidence.location: official Rio Grande Games Dominion 2nd Edition rulebook pp.2–3, lines 18–33 and 111–133 of the PDF text view
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: 500-card inventory; 7 always-used Basic piles plus 10 variable Kingdom piles; base counts; 2-player vs 3–4-player Victory pile sizes; Curse pile sizes; starting deck; Trash mat; player-zone visibility distinctions.

structureEvidence.location: Rio Grande Games official Dominion product page
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: 2nd Edition product identity; edition alignment with RIO531 base pack.

structureEvidence.access: downloaded and rendered pp.3–5 directly viewed; official Rio Grande text crosschecked
structureEvidence.location: 2nd Edition 2016 English, setup p.3, player areas/action p.4, buy/cleanup p.5, base card notes pp.10–15
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: 17 piles, all-player deck/hand/play/discard, temporary card look/reveal/set-aside, pile versus physical-card identity. Official publisher PDF text was readable but direct download403; Steam-hosted licensed digital-game rulebook used for local diagrams.

setup.kingdomSelection: choose any 10 of 26 base Kingdom piles

supply.slotSemantics: one slot represents one card pile, never one card

basicPiles.startingSupply: 60 physical minus 7 per player started in decks

deck.order: preserve if known; otherwise unknown, never infer
deck.count: record if known; null if unknown

inPlay.include: played Actions/Treasures and publicly pending resolution cards; no expansion Duration cards are injected

aside.note: Base card effects may temporarily look at, reveal or set aside cards. Per-card visibility is recorded; the zone is not assumed empty.

coordinates.cardScene: individual card x/y/rotation/layer; unbounded per-zone content shown with a fitted viewport

tableModel.cardIdentity: Each physical copy has a unique instance id; equal printed card names do not merge physical copies. A Supply slot stores a pile and may be empty without disappearing.
tableModel.discardVisibility: Top card is public; do not expose the complete saved discard content automatically just because the top is face-up. Preserve known order, reveal history and owner-hidden transient information.
tableModel.privateTransientZones: Library/Sentry/Vassal and other base actions can reveal/look/set aside cards temporarily. Keep real physical instances and visibility plus the pending step rather than silently completing the effect.

completeStructures: all seven Basic and ten selected Kingdom supply-pile positions
typed card, pile, ownership, ordering and pending-resolution JSON
diagramOnly: card silhouettes in player zones are not initial hand counts
17 Supply slots each represent a pile, not one physical card
per-turn counter wells are original aids, not base-set token inventory
